name: branding-briola-bakery-cafe-identity-long-scroll-in-maroon-and-cream
title: Briola bakery-café identity long scroll: maroon and cream, coffee-bean 'B' monogram, packaging and signage
whatItIs: A tall presentation in maroon and cream: logo explanation (coffee bean + B = monogram), business cards, a pastry shop window, coffee cups, a donut box, storefront signage, menus, a loyalty card, social posts, bags and a website, ending with a script 'Thank you'.
whatItMeans: Warm and classic; one deep colour and a soft serif carry the brand across every touchpoint.
techniques: Explain the logo as an equation of ideas.
Apply the brand to many real touchpoints in sequence.
Keep a strict two-colour palette throughout.

vocabulary.definition: Any place a customer meets the brand.
An explanation of how a logo was built.
